product_metadata.title: ITSOFT Plush Microfiber Long Runner - Non Slip Soft Bathroom Rug, Absorbent Machine Washable Chenille Bath Mat | Quick Dry Carpet, Great for Bath, Shower, Bedroom, or Door Mat (Beige, 47x21)
features: SOFT LUXURY AND NON SKID SAFETY: Our mats made are made of 100% ultra-soft 1 inch tall plush chenille microfiber which keeps your feet nice and warm, your floors dry, and ensures you dont slip after your bath or shower.

LONG LASTING 3 LAYERS : We use a machine washable PVC backing for long lasting use and minimum fiber loss, a 6mm thick foam layer for anti fatigue, and a non slip underside for extra safety. Please do not place your mat over a wet floor or it will not stay in place as intended.

MACHINE WASHABLE: Our mats are easy to clean, just toss them in the wash! DIRECTIONS : Put your rug in a laundry bag (to protect the fibers), use cold water only (and no bleach), and hang to air dry or in the dryer at the lowest heat setting. The colors will stay vibrant after many washes!
SUPER ABSORBENCY: Microfiber is great in wet environments due to their ability to absorb and not feel wet. 1 Inch shag pile for maximum effectiveness!

WE ARE RUG PEOPLE: We are passionate about our workmanship and quality and we work every day with our factory to delivery only the best products to our custumers. Please feel free to contact us with any questions!
